description: This file defines the ScorecardData class which encapsulates information related to a scorecard, including identifiers, user info, survey details, and associated scorecard values. It provides constructors, getters, setters, and a static factory method.

classes.name: ScorecardData
classes.description: A data model class representing a scorecard with metadata and list of score values.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ScorecardData instance with specified properties.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this scorecard.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with this scorecard.

methods.name: getScorecardValues
methods.description: Returns the list of scorecard values.

methods.name: setScorecardValues
methods.description: Sets the list of scorecard values, adding all provided values to the existing list.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username associated with the scorecard.

methods.name: getSurveyId
methods.description: Returns the survey ID associated with this scorecard.
